project_type: React 18 + Vite 5 SPA with Netlify Edge Function serverless proxy. PWA-enabled. No backend/database — all persistence via IndexedDB (Dexie). No auth.
language: TypeScript (strict mode, noEmit: true in tsconfig.json)
build_system: Vite 5 with @vitejs/plugin-react and vite-plugin-pwa. IMPORTANT: vite.config.ts sets process.env.ROLLUP_WASM='true' to avoid native binary issues on Windows — never remove this. Path alias '@/' resolves to 'src/'.
test_framework: None installed. Verification is: 'npm run build:typecheck' (tsc --noEmit, 0 errors) + 'npm run build' (Vite build, 0 errors). Run these after every FEAT.
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'npm run build:typecheck' in C:\Users\PALLAVI M\Desktop\Thinkr — must exit with 0 TS errors. 2. Run 'npm run build' — must complete without errors and produce dist/. 3. For Phase 19 final check: run 'npm run preview' and confirm app loads.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ is generated by 'npm run build'. Do not commit dist/ — it is in .gitignore. The setup step already committed the initial scaffold.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell environment. Workspace root: C:\Users\PALLAVI M\Desktop\Thinkr. All absolute paths in commands must quote paths with spaces. Use forward slashes in TypeScript imports. ROLLUP_WASM=true must stay in vite.config.ts. Do not run 'npm install' for new packages without checking package.json first — all required dependencies are already installed.
contribution_requirements: All changes must be in the workspace root C:\Users\PALLAVI M\Desktop\Thinkr. Commit locally on the branch after each FEAT using 'git add' (specific files) and 'git commit'. Never push. Never use --no-verify. The setup step already created the initial commit — build on top of it.
key_patterns: 1. Tailwind uses CSS variables for theming: 'darkMode: ["selector", "[data-theme=dark]"]' and tokens like 'colors.primary: "var(--primary)"'. 2. Path alias '@/' maps to 'src/'. 3. Framer Motion for all animations; check useReducedMotion() and skip animations when true. 4. Zustand stores use 'zustand/middleware persist' for localStorage persistence. 5. Dexie v4 schema: 'db.version(1).stores({...})'. 6. No external drag library — use HTML5 drag events. 7. KaTeX via react-katex with throwOnError: false. 8. All components follow shadcn-style: CVA variants + cn() utility from '@/lib/utils'. 9. Netlify edge function at netlify/edge-functions/chat.ts (NOT netlify/functions/). 10. NEVER send whole PDF text to LLM — only top 3-4 BM25 chunks, ~1200 tokens max.
